dct_title_s: Spain - Flood in Alicante-Valencia Regions, Spain (EMSR935)
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping products for activation EMSR935. On 19 October 2026, an episode of adverse weather affecting the south of Valencia province and the north of Alicante is impacting a large number of people. Up to 500 rescues were carried out within 12 hours, with several fatalities reported and communities affected by disruptions to essential services, including electricity and drinking water supplies. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial roughestimation and flood extent emergency mapping. **Citation:** Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2026 European Union), EMSR935 **Product types present in this dataset's resources:** **DEL (Delineation)**: maps the extent of the event itself (eg. flood, fire, landslide boundary). **GRA (Grading)**: assesses damage to individual features (eg. buildings, infrastructure). Where a GeoPackage download is available for an Area of Interest/round, it already contains every layer with its official Copernicus styling and colours - prefer it in GIS software over the zipped shapefile download.
